purpose: Prospective evaluation of BTC/USD hourly forecasts; no model scores were inspected to design this protocol. Revision 1.0.1 clarifies provenance enforcement, exact fractional-time pairing, interval estimands and family-wise resampling before any evaluation score access.

market.vintage_identity: immutable source snapshot identifier plus SHA-256 of normalized timestamp and close series

pairing.timestamps: ISO-8601 UTC with Z or +00:00; no naive timestamps
pairing.target_rule: target_at = origin_at + horizon_hours exactly with zero fractional-second remainder
pairing.forecast_information_cutoff: origin_at inclusive; every feature and model-selection datum must have been available by origin_at; each row must record input_available_at, selection_data_through, nonempty vintage_id and lowercase 64-hex vintage_sha256
pairing.failure_denominator: Report attempted, scored, failed, abstained, missing and ineligible counts/rates per model, horizon, stratum and whole family. Do not impute failures, silently drop attempts, or compare metrics on unmatched rows. Primary paired skill uses exact keys scored by both; availability and failure-rate differences are reported separately and any candidate failure-rate regression blocks eligibility.

point.formula: r=ln(actual_target_price/origin_price); r_hat=ln(predicted_target_price/origin_price); loss=abs(r_hat-r); report mean loss by horizon and equally-weighted mean of the four horizon means
point.rationale: scale-free, additive return error matching the forecast target; primary aggregation gives each declared horizon equal weight

secondary.direction: Compare sign(r_hat) with sign(r); abstain from classifying either value when abs(value)<=1e-6 log-return (10 bp); report eligible directional denominator, accuracy and candidate-minus-comparator directional error rate. Near-zero excluded from direction only, never point loss.

point.invalid_prices: Nonfinite or nonpositive prices are failed attempts and counted; no metric imputation.

interval.outcome: Cumulative target log return y=ln(P_target/P_origin), evaluated on the same exact target outcome as point forecasts
interval.units: dimensionless log-return units for quantiles, pinball, Winkler score, and width; report width additionally as 100*(U-L) percent of origin price
interval.bounds: L=predicted q10 cumulative log return and U=predicted q90 cumulative log return; require finite L<=U and reject crossing/nonfinite bounds as failed attempts
interval.pinball: For each q in {0.1,0.5,0.9}, rho_q(y-Qq)=max(q*(y-Qq),(q-1)*(y-Qq)); average per quantile over exact scored pairs; lower is better
interval.primary_interval_score: 80% Winkler score in log-return units: (U-L)+(2/0.20)*(L-y)*I(y<L)+(2/0.20)*(y-U)*I(y>U); lower is better
interval.coverage: mean(I(L<=y<=U)); nominal 0.80, report observed minus nominal and exact denominator
interval.width: mean(U-L) in log-return units, also report mean(100*(exp(U)-exp(L))) as interval width percent of origin price
interval.bootstrap: Pair candidate-minus-comparator per-origin interval scores on exact shared keys; resample the same 24-origin moving blocks as point outcomes and retain within-stratum membership; never resample rows independently
interval.interpretation: Coverage alone is not probabilistic skill; proper score and width must accompany coverage. Interval outcomes do not substitute for point-loss tests.

comparisons.selection: At each outer origin choose the single baseline with lowest primary loss on inner training-only purged folds; freeze choice before outer outcomes mature; ties resolve lexicographically by baseline identifier.

strata: training-only volatility tercile with cutpoints frozen per outer fold

minimum_effective_sample.rule: All confirmatory comparisons and primary horizon cells must meet both minima; otherwise blocked/inconclusive, never pooled to bypass a failing cell.

sampling.effective_sample: number of nonoverlapping dependence blocks; report raw paired-origin count and block count

design.selection: nested expanding walk-forward; each inner/outer training set excludes observations whose target has not matured before its boundary; purge at least 16 hours and embargo at least 24 hours
design.holdout: one chronological, untouched final holdout reserved before selection; no protocol tuning or model selection on it
design.d3: separate prospective shadow after training/selection and holdout lock; at least 30 calendar days and 200 mature exact pairs per horizon; D3 is not used to modify this protocol
design.cutoff: fixed calendar cutoff and dataset-vintage manifest must be registered before first evaluation score; no interim score access
design.stopping: single analysis at the frozen cutoff after all planned outcomes mature; no optional stopping or early efficacy/futility looks
design.practical_effect_definition: at least 3% relative reduction in primary mean loss versus each required comparator

limits.per_horizon_regression: simultaneous adjusted upper confidence bound for candidate-minus-comparator primary loss must not exceed 5% of comparator mean loss
limits.directional_loss: simultaneous adjusted upper confidence bound for candidate-minus-comparator directional error rate must not exceed 0.02 absolute

design.promotion: No automatic promotion; eligible_for_human_review is not approval.

uncertainty.method: Moving-block bootstrap of per-origin paired candidate-minus-comparator loss-difference vectors; use the same sampled origin blocks jointly across every registered model, horizon, endpoint and stratum. For each replicate retain only the frozen memberships of each stratum; do not sample independently within cells or treat strata as independent origins.
uncertainty.overlap_rule: 24 hourly origins covers the maximum 16-hour target overlap; use complete blocks and report effective block count
uncertainty.interval: two-sided 95% percentile intervals and bootstrap two-sided p-values from the paired loss-difference distribution; apply the family adjustment to p-values and report adjusted intervals/conclusions
uncertainty.strata_handling: Compute each predeclared stratum estimand from the jointly resampled origin blocks using its frozen membership; preserve cross-stratum and cross-horizon dependence in every replicate; empty/undersized cells are blocked and are never dropped from the registered family.

multiplicity.registered_test_family: Before any score access, enumerate and hash every candidate-versus-required-comparator test for primary point loss and every declared confirmatory endpoint (per-horizon point, direction, interval score, pinball quantiles, and coverage diagnostics) across all four horizons and every predeclared regime/volatility stratum. Holm-adjust the complete registered family as one family; no test or stratum may be added, removed, or redefined after inspection.
multiplicity.failure_handling: Every registered test remains in the Holm family regardless of failed/aborted evaluation, missing data, or ineligibility; report unavailable tests as blocked with no p-value and do not shrink the adjustment family.

immutability.no_peeking: Protocol, candidate identities, vintage, boundaries, cutoffs, strata, multiplicity family and attempt ledger are hashed before outcome access; access logs retained
immutability.changes: Any change requires a new version and digest before a new independent evaluation; prior results remain exploratory and cannot be relabeled confirmatory
